rationale:
Issue #1809 reports that changing the length of an unrelated string (testOn: 'vm' vs 'vm && linux') incorrectly affects formatting of a test call with a block-formatted closure. The production patch in lib/src/piece/list.dart fixes the exact defect by correcting the line-length calculation in fixedStateForPageWidth: it now resets currentLineLength when encountering block-formattable elements (allowNewlinesWhenUnsplit), recognizing that elements before and after are not on the same line, and adds the missing 2-character comma+space accounting. The minimized production patch contains only this algorithmic fix with no refactoring, formatting, or feature additions. The trigger test added in test/tall/regression/1800/1809.unit exercises both the 'vm' and 'vm && linux' cases from the issue, and comes from the same fix commit (later merged to main at 155c6aed). Runtime validation confirms deterministic buggy-fail/fixed-pass behavior across 3 repetitions with full-suite green on fixed. No active same-project root causes provided for duplication check.

Issue #1809 (bug-labeled) reports that the length of an unrelated `testOn:` string argument changes whether `test(...)` keeps its block-formatted closure form. The minimized production patch touches exactly one hunk in lib/src/piece/list.dart, in ListPiece.fixedStateForPageWidth, replacing the single accumulated `totalLength` with a `surroundingLength` plus a per-line `currentLineLength` that resets when an element has `allowNewlinesWhenUnsplit`, so elements separated by a block-formatted element are no longer summed as if they shared a line. That is precisely the mechanism the issue describes, and the commit/PR text states the same root cause and closes #1809. No formatting-only, documentation, configuration, dependency, or test changes appear in patches/minimized-production.patch; the identifier rename and new comments are inside the rewritten logic itself rather than an adjacent refactor. The trigger is the upstream fixture test/tall/regression/1800/1809.unit from later commit 155c6aed, a data-driven input/expected pair reproducing the issue's exact `testOn: 'vm && linux'` case plus the already-correct `testOn: 'vm'` control; it is consumed by the pre-existing test/tall_format_test.dart runner and introduces no new production API, so it applies to both revisions. Strict evidence shows both revisions build, selector test/tall_format_test.dart::tall/regression/1800/1809.unit fails in isolation and in-suite on the buggy revision across 3 repetitions with deterministic fingerprints, the fixed revision is clean isolated/suite/reversed, and the fixed full suite is all green with buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced trigger. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and the root cause matches the sole allowed id.
